hero.imagen_alt: Freshly groomed standard poodle sitting calmly after a full groom at Passion Fur Pets

parrafo_1.es: Passion Fur Pets es un salón de peluquería integral en Bartow para perros y gatos de todas las razas y tamaños. Baños, cortes, corte de uñas y el trato paciente que convierte una primera visita nerviosa en una cita tranquila de siempre.
parrafo_1.en: Passion Fur Pets is a full-service grooming salon in Bartow for dogs and cats of every breed and size. Baths, haircuts, nail trims, and the kind of patient handling that turns a nervous first visit into a calm regular one.

parrafo_2.es: Los clientes vuelven durante años, y las reseñas repiten lo mismo: paciencia con mascotas que otros groomers ya habían rechazado. Un shiba que mordía y aullaba hoy, en palabras de su dueña, es un cliente que mejora visita a visita.
parrafo_2.en: Clients keep coming back for years, and the reviews point to the same thing: patience with pets that other groomers had given up on. One shiba that used to bite and howl is now, in his owner's words, a client who keeps getting better.

texto.es: Cuéntanos la raza de tu mascota y qué necesita: baño, corte, uñas o los tres.
texto.en: Tell us your pet's breed and what it needs: a bath, a haircut, nails, or all three.

texto.es: Buscamos un horario dentro de nuestros días de atención en Bartow.
texto.en: We find a time that works within our hours in Bartow.

texto.es: Baño, corte y uñas con la paciencia necesaria, incluso con mascotas nerviosas.
texto.en: Bath, haircut and nails, with the patience to work even with nervous pets.

texto.es: Tu perro o gato sale limpio, cómodo y luciendo su mejor corte.
texto.en: Your dog or cat goes home clean, comfortable and looking its best.

nota.es: Cada corte se cotiza según raza, tamaño y estado del pelaje. Llama y te damos un precio claro.

subtitulo.en: 137 reviews on Google, rated 4.8 out of 5.

items.quote: Had a shiba that had been kicked out n refused by every groomer in area. He'd bite, he'd howl. This place had patience to get him used to getting his nails clipped. He's now a C+ client, lol, and is getting better. If you have a dog that's been labeled difficult, this is the place.
Paris Rose got her first haircut today! Wonderful place to go and get your pet's hair done! Give them a call if you need your baby groomed! They took such good care of her!

Passion fur Pets are the greatest. They go the extra mile to take care of our fur babies. My dogs always look their best. Been going to them for 7 years now and will continue. They really care and that means a lot!

Max and I love Passion Fur Pets! I have been taking my dog Max there for several years and they do a great job. Jacob and the staff are great. Max gets excited when I ask him if he wants to go see Jacob. I highly recommend them!
